purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: ONACA is evidenced as Haiti's national cadastral custodian. Public SIA and CNIGS/HaitiData routes were inspected, but only administrative/thematic geography was verified; no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: MTPTC's official institutional page identifies ONACA and assigns it responsibility for establishing the general cadastre. This is national custody evidence, not proof of a Gonaïves local registry office or citywide digital parcel coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official MTPTC page identifies ONACA and its responsibility for establishing Haiti's general cadastre.
Official ONACA activity material describes cadastral production in intervention areas and limitations of national coverage; it does not provide a public Gonaïves parcel API.
Official CNIGS page describes HaitiData as a public GeoNode-based geospatial data platform.
Official SIA Haïti map shell exposes department, commune, section, watershed, river, and city layers.
Official IHSI geographic database page exposes thematic map images, including Artibonite, not parcel geometry.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Leaflet public map with JSON endpoints for administrative boundaries; CNIGS HaitiData advertises GeoNode and exposes a public GeoServer WFS capabilities document.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: SIA boundary endpoints return GeoJSON; returned geometry coordinates are longitude/latitude. HaitiData WFS capabilities advertise EPSG:4326 for relevant public layers. No parcel schema or parcel CRS was verified.
viewerConfiguration.sourceFieldMapping: SIA commune response uses properties.nom and feature id; Gonaives was feature id 104. These are administrative identifiers and were not retained as parcel identities.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: HTTP 200 public Leaflet viewer retrieved; current JavaScript inspected. It references /geo/geojson/departement, /geo/geojson/commune, and /geo/geojson/section only; no parcel route was present.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON administrative response; Gonaives is feature id 104. This is a commune MultiPolygon, not a cadastral parcel response.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON department boundaries; administrative only.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON section boundaries; administrative only.
HTTP 200 WFS capabilities; public feature list inspected. No layer name matching parcel, cadastre, lot, or parcelle was identified; no GetFeature request was made.
HTTP 200; official thematic map page retrieved. It provides raster map links, not cadastral parcel geometry.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous cadastral parcel response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: No parcel GetFeature query was submitted because the public WFS capabilities did not expose a parcel/cadastre layer and SIA exposed only administrative layers.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National ONACA cadastral custody plus public CNIGS/HaitiData and SIA distribution channels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative boundaries and WFS service metadata only; no parcel geometry.

remainingUncertainty: A non-public, offline, or separately hosted ONACA/municipal dataset may exist. SIA administrative geometry and HTTP 404/absence of a WFS layer are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous native parcel ID plus complete polygon response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
